purpose: silver_online_retail_ii cleans the bronze online_retail_ii capture into a deduplicated, typed table of retail transaction line items keyed on invoice and stockcode, intended to feed sales, returns, and customer behavior analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat invoice plus stockcode as the unique grain, branch or filter on the derived is_return flag when analyzing net sales versus returns, and handle customer_id as optional since nearly 30% of rows lack a customer identifier.
limitations: Exact duplicate rows (duplicate_row_rate 0.011188) are dropped but no evidence of clock-drift duplicates was found in the airbyte extraction timestamps, so only exact-duplicate handling is applied; customer_id remains null for 29.778% of rows and description is null for 0.504% of rows, both retained rather than imputed; description and stockcode free-text values were not standardized beyond type casting.
